component.name: Chip
component.description: Pill-shaped filter toggle. Each chip is an independent toggle button (aria-pressed); the page owns which chips are pressed. Default: neutral border and subtle text. Pressed: brand border and brand text. Pure filter indicator — not a navigation element. Label-only; no dropdown arrow.

useWhen: Filtering a list or carousel by category (e.g. All Courses, Design, Development)
Multi-select filtering: each chip toggles one filter on or off independently
Showing current filter state visually — a pressed chip reads as brand-colored

notFor.case: Using Chip for navigation that changes the URL
notFor.because: Chip renders a <button> — links that produce a URL change should be <a> elements.

notFor.case: Using Chip for a primary call-to-action
notFor.because: Chips signal filter/selection; they carry no action weight.

notFor.case: Using Chip with a dropdown arrow
notFor.because: The dropdown variant is out of scope; the page uses label-only chips.

useWhen.false: Resting state. Transparent background, subtle text, default border.
useWhen.true: Active selection. Brand border and brand text to signal the active filter.

donts.case: Placing a Chip alongside a Button in the same Inline row as interactive siblings
donts.because: Chip is a selection toggle (state); Button is an action trigger (event). Mixing them in the same row conflates filtering with acting and confuses interaction semantics.
donts.instead: Group Chips in their own Inline filter bar. Place action Buttons in a separate row. Never use Chip as a substitute for a Button or vice versa.

donts.case: A row of Chips without a group name
donts.because: Screen readers announce each chip as 'toggle button, pressed' with no indication of what the chips filter or that they belong together.
donts.instead: Give the Inline role=group and aria-labelledby pointing at the nearest heading (or an aria-label).

patterns.name: filter-bar
patterns.useWhen: Narrowing a list by categories the user toggles. Multi-select by default; single-select when the page keeps one active value (page logic, same tree).
